rationale: The MAA/RN/2025/04 document, effective 10 October 2025, explicitly states that for Certified Air Systems, the applicant 'should raise a Military Certification Review Item (MCRI) for MAA agreement' (p. 2, para 6). It also 'recommends that early applications of ML techniques for Air System PE use the most appropriate training methods (eg supervised learning using large, high-quality datasets) to generate models that then remain fixed for system integration and use within a defined operational design domain' (p. 2, para 7). This directly supports all elements of the claim regarding the applicant-specific path, MCRI requirement, and recommendations for fixed supervised models within a defined ODD for early safety-related ML applications within the specified UK military aviation scope.
